name: A Better Ingredient
summary: Torwa Pathfinder seeks a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple. You are asked to bring it back to him.

sections.title: The Sunken Temple
sections.body: The guardian at the Sunken Temple's bottom holds a Putrid Vine that Torwa Pathfinder wants. You are to retrieve it and return to Torwa with the vine.

faq.answer: Torwa Pathfinder asks you to bring him a Putrid Vine.
The Putrid Vine is with the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple.

faq.q: What do I bring back to Torwa?
faq.answer: Bring Torwa Pathfinder a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Better Ingredient
